text.description_html:
Acorn WT6BI, 13-1/2 Inch Warwick Single Cylinder Handleset

The 13-1/2 inch Warwick Single Cylinder Mortise Handle With Knob features a s-shaped grip off set by lovely mounts that look as if they have been inspired by nature. It is perfect for restoration projects because of its old world design and material. The black iron finish is guaranteed not to rust. For doors 1-3/4 inch - 3 inch thick with 2-1/2 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. A single cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. It is graded for large, heavy doors.

Unlike a simple tubular latch, this is a mortise lock. They are extremely durable and have a tighter clearance tolerance. You know it's a mortise lock when you hear that heavy, smooth, solid 'click' when the door closes shut.

Single Cylinder Handleset: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the interior, the knob operates the latch and a thumbturn operates the deadbolt.

Also Available Matching:
13-1/2" Warwick Dummy Handle With Knob
Half Round Rough Black Iron Knob

Features of the 13-1/2" Warwick Single Cylinder Mortise Handle With Knob:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Heavy gauge plated steel mortise case.
  • Anti-friction brass latch bolt.
  • The deadbolt is made of brass with hardened steel inserts.
  • Panic Proof: Turning of inside knob will retract both deadbolt and latchbolt at the same time.
  • Package Includes: inside knob, rose, thumbturn, cylinder, outside handle, and all necessary mounting hardware.
  • Lifetime Finish Warranty

Specification for the Acorn WT6BI Mortise Handleset:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Exterior Cylinder Rose Length: 2-7/8"
  • Exterior Cylinder Rose Width: 2-1/8"
  • Exterior Handle Length: 13-1/2"
  • Exterior Handle Width: 3-1/4"
  • Interior Knob Diameter: 2"
  • Interior Rose Length: 2-1/2"
  • Interior Rose Width: 1-1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4" Standard, Optional up to 3" thick doors
  • Backset: 2-1/2" or 2-3/4"
  • Mortise: 8” x 1-1/4”
  • Case: 6” x 3-5/8” x 15/16”
  • Latch Bolt: 3/4” throw
  • Deadbolt: 1” throw
  • Strike: 4-7/8” ASA
  • Thumb Turn Hubs: 3/16” on the diamond.
  • Keyway: Schlage C-Keyway

The handing actually refers to the mortise lock, rather than the knob. Click Here to Determine Handing
